rulesClauses: Choose two - Up to one target unit becomes distant. / Prevent the next 2 damage that would be dealt to each distant unit this turn. / Load Viridescent Aetherstreak into an Aetherwing weapon you control.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. ViridescentAetherstreakTargetA was queued without dontSkipOnPass, so declining the first mode's optional target (MZMAYCHOOSE answered PASS) made ExecuteStaticMethods() skip the handler, which is what asks the remaining mode: the card stopped after one mode (live repro on HEAD: queue empty, card left in the graveyard instead of loading into the Aetherwing). Fix: dontSkipOnPass:1 at the queue site.
